compatible_reuse_opportunities.application: A separate rooted-tree export can represent the 16 family IDs with finite natural-number addresses while retaining stable IDs, notation and exact external rows. An added administrative root is not a seventeenth method family or a method record.
required_premises: Explicit deterministic ID/address mapping and inverse on exported identities; slots, prefix closure and exact membership.
Preserve non-tree relations outside the tree projection.
Replay actual generated terms; a theorem name in metadata is not a checked instance.

compatible_reuse_opportunities.application: A primary assignment and optional secondary references roll up one underlying record without duplicating a declaration. This can express mathematical homes or method facets only when those dimensions are explicitly separated.
required_premises: Supply the exact Artifact universe and a total primary assignment on that universe.
The empty supplied method universe is honest empty coverage; it does not prove a 215-record catalogue.
Keep mathematical subject/object homes distinct from primary method-family facets.

compatible_reuse_opportunities.application: Keep snapshots, source roles, editorial classification and reported verification scopes/receipts separate. A classification can be reviewed while native proof replay remains NOT_RUN.

Receipt/source digests remain evidence references; they do not prove source authenticity, permission or hash injectivity.
